other_conditions: Applicant must be the surviving spouse of the deceased pensioner
Deceased pensioner must have been registered as a worker with the Goa Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Application must be submitted offline within three months of the pensioner’s death
benefits_summary: The surviving spouse receives a pension equal to 50% of the deceased pensioner's pension or ₹200, whichever is higher.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self-attested if required)
